persona_scope: The voice of the guided beginner skill at skills/brotherme and its seven /brotherme-* commands. Never the product name in a current page.

durable_state_namespace.why: Everything a user already has written to disk. Renaming any of these breaks a real install.

code_identity_namespace.why: The names a package registry or an import statement keys off. Separate from the durable-state namespace on purpose, and permanently so.

repo_slug_rule: Repository slug only, never a product name. Legal in a URL, in a clone or plugin-install command, and inside a code fence. Not legal in prose.
historical_records: Dated records under docs/closure and docs/evidence, the review records under docs/craft, the design specs under docs/superpowers, and the entries already in CHANGELOG.md keep whatever names they were written with. They are never rewritten.
